For more information on how we collect and use this information, please review our Privacy PolicyGot ItAnnouncementsSpecial Trading HoursStore OpeningsCaring For Our CommunitiesCustomer UpdatesRecallsTrader Joe's Open Regular Hours on Easter SundaySpecial Trading HoursMarch 25, 2026No matter how people celebrate Easter, you can bet that great food is always a part of the equation. At Trader Joe's, great values are part of that equation, too! For your Easter festivities, we have Uncured Spiral Sliced Hams, Four Cheese Scalloped Potatoes, Haricot Verts, and lots and lots of Candy! And this year, you'll have more time on Easter to pick up your favorites. All Trader Joe's locations will be open regular hours on Sunday, April 5th.* (*Except Trader Joe's Portland, Maine, which will be Closed on April 5th.)
